replies.author: thmf
replies.text:
limpopo My bad, I misread what your issue is. Seems you're asking for kind of a "call logs scopes" feature. Currently, GrapheneOS doesn't have that.

You could try using Viber in an always running in background secondary profile which will have separate call logs, but I imagine it won't be very convenient for a realtime communication app.

replies.author: limpopo
replies.text: thmf second profile is absolutely not a problem, but secondary profile, to use a phone, requires phone and sms permission and when given, it displays all the calls and sms from the main profile - viber then sees call logs anyway. Not an option

replies.text: @limpopo just FYI my Viber instance works just fine with just Microphone, Network and Notifications permissions. Of course it's my secondary installation (it thinks it's a tablet), I don't know if the primary one makes a difference, I'll have to test it.
